description:
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch's first ability by tapping it.
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Elegant Entourage triggers, giving Cinderhaze Wretch +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Cinderhaze Wretch ability from step 2, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.name: Cinderhaze Wretch
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it
